subject: GalaxyX intake: scope, version pin request & timebox
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Henry Lopez <henry@edgescale.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: GalaxyX intake: scope, version pin request & timebox

Team / Henry —

We're starting intake for EdgeScale's GalaxyX (r1) family. Quick ask: we need a short cross-functional decision tonight on whether to request a temporary version pin for GalaxyX r1 on Redwood Dedicated while we run tokenizer parity, kernel compatibility, and telemetry gating. EdgeScale is targeting production use in late July and asked for a staging slot the week of 7/5.

High-level scope & asks (please respond inline):
- Compatibility checklist: tokenizer parity, bpe/endian checks, KV cache layout, and quantization profile (attached: galaxyx-compat-matrix.xlsx).
- Safety & telemetry gating: define a minimal eval set and rollout metric (Priyom, can you propose a template?).
- Rollout constraint: request a 2-week pin window (start when we approve ingress) to prevent auto-rollforward while we validate.
- Canaries & fallback: propose a fallback variant (e.g., galaxyx-lite / galaxiav1-compat) and an ingress canary plan.
- Business ask (Henry): provide cost delta for pinned capacity vs. best-effort routing.

Attachments: galaxyx-compat-matrix.xlsx, galaxyx-integration-checklist.pdf, telemetry-gating-template.md

If we can't complete the checks before EdgeScale's requested staging slot, I'm inclined to grant the temporary pin with a 14-day timebox and tight telemetry gates. Please reply with availability & blockers by EOD PST so I can confirm to EdgeScale.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Partnerships & Integrations
Redwood Inference

---
Note: Henry is external; internal recipients only are the Redwood owners listed above.
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Henry Lopez <henry@edgescale.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GalaxyX intake: scope, version pin request & timebox

Vanessa — thanks for the clear checklist. Quick technical clarifications from runtime: 

On Fri, 18 Jun 2027 at 09:12 -0700, Vanessa Ortiz wrote:
> High-level scope & asks:
> - Compatibility checklist: tokenizer parity, bpe/endian checks, KV cache layout, and quantization profile (attached: galaxyx-compat-matrix.xlsx).

A couple items I need to scope the effort and surface blockers:
- Tokenizer: do you have a reference tokenizer fileset or a small sample corpus? Tokenizer parity failures are the most frequent onboarding blocker. If EdgeScale can drop a 1k-line sample file we can run a parity pass in ~24 hrs.
- KV cache / attention cache: is GalaxyX using fused KV shapes or a standard causal layout? That changes our kernel selection.
- Quantization: are they requesting an int8 profile or we should test int4-first? The compat matrix should include expected latency targets per profile.

If we can get the sample artifacts today I can queue a compile/compat run tomorrow. Regarding the pin: I'm fine with a 14-day pin if the pin request includes an explicit rollback and traffic cutover plan. Suggest we reserve a staging GPU slot 7/5-7/9 for canary + perf runs.

-Karthik
Principal SW Engineer, Serving Runtime
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Henry Lopez <henry@edgescale.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GalaxyX intake: scope, version pin request & timebox

Vanessa / Karthik —

Availability: my infra team has an open staging slot on 7/6-7/8 (we can shift the slot by a day if needed). If Karthik wants to run the parity compile the week of 6/21 we can parallelize the perf matrix.

Operational asks:
- I'll need a single canonical checklist itemized (Laura-runbook) that calls out: artifacts, perf targets, telemetry hooks, and rollback steps. I can draft that if Priyom and Karthik provide their gate criteria.
- Cost: Henry, can you share a rough delta for reserving dedicated capacity versus burst routing? We'll need that to sign the pin approval.

CC'ing Priyom for the telemetry gate template — Priyom, can you paste the drive link with the gating template?

-Laura
Staff Product Manager, Platform
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Henry Lopez <henry@edgescale.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GalaxyX intake: scope, version pin request & timebox

Thanks — I've uploaded a minimal telemetry gating template and a suggested eval prompt set to the Drive folder: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/1GxGalaxyXIntake (see telemetry-gating-template.md attachment).

My recommendations (short):
- Gate metric: production KL drift + token-error-rate on the canonical prompt set; thresholds: <4% drift, TER <0.8% for 48 hours to clear canary.
- Canary plan: 2% of traffic routed to GalaxyX r1 for 24 hrs, observe gating; if pass, escalate to 20% for 48 hrs then wide release.
- Pin policy: grant 14-day pin but make it conditional — pin expires automatically unless both canary and perf gates are green and the telemetry snapshot is uploaded to the shared Drive.
- Fallback: use galaxiav1-compat (older minor version) as immediate fallback. Karthik: if tokenizers mismatch we should do a deterministic mapping layer for the canary only.

I can shepherd the gating checks if we agree on the metric set. Attaching telemetry-gating-template.md for review.

-Priyom
Applied ML / Observability
From: Henry Lopez <henry@edgescale.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GalaxyX intake: scope, version pin request & timebox

Vanessa / team — thanks for the checklist and the quick turnaround. EdgeScale can provide:
- Tokenizer reference bundle and a 2k-line sample corpus by EOD 6/18 (I will drop it in the Drive folder).
- A preliminary cost delta for pinned capacity vs. shared routing by 6/22.

We agree to the proposed gating flow; we'll hold our staging promotion until Redwood confirms the canary window. If you need a technical contact on our side for tokenization questions, loop in me and our integration lead Priya Shah (pri@edgescale.com).

Henry Lopez
Head of Integrations, EdgeScale
